status: Proposed course rubric; instructor approval pending
basis: Supplied ESDP revision 2023-01 template, chapters 1-11 and appendices A-C; alternate-format Orchid example used for heading aliases only. Examples are not graded reference answers. Referenced operator standards were not supplied or independently verified.

levels.3: Clear, specific and internally consistent coverage

criteria.title: Identity and revision control
criteria.expectation: Experiment identity, responsible contacts, campaign context, dated revision history and traceable changes. Do not require birth dates or other unnecessary personal data.

criteria.title: Objectives and experiment overview
criteria.expectation: Understandable scientific objective and explanation of how the setup and operations address it.

criteria.title: Equipment and system descriptions
criteria.expectation: All systems, component references and functions, operations and referenced block diagrams; pressure-system detail where applicable.

criteria.title: Products and containment
criteria.expectation: In-flight fluids, gases, powders and chemicals with quantities, purpose, containment and SDS references; explicit reasoned non-applicability is acceptable. External SDS files cannot be verified here.

criteria.title: Aircraft interfaces and specifications
criteria.expectation: Layout, crew and roles, rack and loose equipment mass/dimensions, stowage, aircraft power and vent needs, nuisance/sensitivity declarations and specific requests.

criteria.title: Electrical systems and batteries
criteria.expectation: Electrical architecture, isolation, protection, grounding and wire sizing where applicable. Inventory all batteries including commercial devices, chemistry, capacity, spares, storage and cutoff. No aircraft power does not imply no electrical hazards.

criteria.title: Structure and mechanical substantiation
criteria.expectation: Primary structure, equipment attachment, mass distribution, load assumptions and referenced calculations or tests; distinguish claimed compliance from demonstrated verification.

criteria.title: Ground and flight procedures
criteria.expectation: Installation, inspections, pre-flight, takeoff/landing, g-phase activities, operator roles, abort/emergency actions, post-flight, transport and ground support. Identify time-critical steps.

criteria.title: External service failures
criteria.expectation: Consequences and safe response to aircraft power loss, rapid cabin depressurization and vent blockage; justified non-applicability where appropriate.

criteria.title: Hazard analysis and verification
criteria.expectation: Hazard inventory, worst foreseeable consequences, severity, causal chains, controls, verification evidence and traceability to hazard reports. Cover experiment-specific hazards and explain N/A declarations.

criteria.title: Requirements and exemptions
criteria.expectation: Applicability and compliance distinguished per requirement, supporting evidence and documented unresolved deviations/exemptions. Do not infer operator approval from a checked box or an exemption request.

criteria.title: References and document consistency
criteria.expectation: External document filenames/purposes, resolvable internal cross-references, consistent counts, mass, configuration and roles across revisions and procedures; unresolved TBDs called out.
